title: Mace Windu
franchise: Star Wars: Attack of the Clones
description: Mace Windu, a powerful and revered Jedi Knight and Master of the Jedi Council, wielded a unique purple-bladed Lightsaber. As the galaxy fractured on the eve of the Clone Wars, Mace Windu led a team of Jedi to Geonosis to rescue Obi-Wan Kenobi from the clutches of Count Dooku and the Separatist Alliance in an attempt to stop the war before it started. Instead, it only intensified.
